note: What contracts/stocks/bin/freeze.py freezes for the Robinhood Memestake package. Names only: every byte, selector, topic, size and digest is derived from the compiler artifacts and the dependency snapshot, never written here.

RobinhoodProtocolRevenueInboxV1.role: Collects the protocol lane in USDG on Robinhood and bridges it to the Base receiver through the Safe-set adapter.
RobinhoodProtocolRevenueInboxV1.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), second in the deployment order after the UERC20 factory

RobinhoodPositionsLib.role: The externally linked library RobinhoodStocksLaunchpadV1 delegates its v4 position building to.
RobinhoodPositionsLib.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), linked into the launchpad

RobinhoodFeeHookFactory.role: Deploys RobinhoodFeeHookV1 at a mined CREATE2 address for the launchpad that calls it.

RobinhoodStocksLaunchpadV1.role: The Robinhood Memestake launchpad: creates the token and the CCA auction per launch, graduates into the official v4 pool, deploys its hook through the factory and its locker and splitter implementation itself.
RobinhoodStocksLaunchpadV1.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), linked against RobinhoodPositionsLib

RobinhoodFeeHookV1.role: The v4 fee hook every official Robinhood pool is initialized with; charges the swap fee lanes in USDG.
RobinhoodFeeHookV1.deployed_by: RobinhoodFeeHookFactory.deploy (CREATE2 with the mined hook salt), called from the launchpad constructor

RobinhoodMemestockSplitterV1.role: The per-launch revenue splitter implementation for Robinhood; each launch receives a Solady minimal-proxy clone of it.
RobinhoodMemestockSplitterV1.deployed_by: RobinhoodStocksLaunchpadV1 constructor (CREATE); cloned per launch by LibClone.clone

MemestockLPLocker.role: Holds every graduated launch's full-range v4 position forever and routes collected fees to the launch's splitter; the same source as the Base package.

RobinhoodStockBidAdapterV1.role: Bids into a launch's auction with STOCK on behalf of msg.sender through the launchpad's admitted route, pulling USDG through Permit2.

UniswapV3StockRouteV1.role: The production USDG <-> STOCK route for one admitted stock: executes on that stock's Uniswap v3 USDG/STOCK pool (either currency order), quotes from its Chainlink feed and refuses any execution more than five percent under the feed.
UniswapV3StockRouteV1.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), one per admitted stock after the bid adapter

RobinhoodBaseRevenueReceiverV1.role: The Base-side address bridged USDC lands on: Base-Safe-attested attribution, permissionless deposit into live REGENT staking, surplus sweep.

ContinuousClearingAuctionFactory.role: The pinned CCA factory build the launchpad binds; the founder supplies the Robinhood deployment.

ContinuousClearingAuction.role: The pinned per-launch auction build the bound factory creates for every launch.
ContinuousClearingAuction.deployed_by: the bound CCA factory, one per launch

PoolManager.role: The pinned Uniswap v4 PoolManager build the hook factory and launchpad bind.

PositionManager.role: The pinned Uniswap v4 PositionManager build the launchpad and locker bind.

UERC20Factory.role: The pinned token factory build; Robinhood Chain carries no deployment with this runtime, so the ceremony creates one first and the launchpad requires its exact runtime hash.
UERC20Factory.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), first in the deployment order
